I'm quoted in #FastCompany re: #Nvidia's likely acquisition of 🤗Inc:

https://www.fastcompany.com/91597304/nvidias-hugging-face-deal-could-reshape-the-open-ai-ecosystem

However, #disturbing that #OSI says that #HuggingFace is currently a “neutral platform”.

Sadly, #OpenSource Initiative (even after #Microsoft's acquisition) considers #GitHub a “thought leader”¹ in framing OSI's LLM-gen-AI policy. But I still hope against hope OSI would drop their decades-long position that “we ❤️ companies that proprietarize non-copyleft #FOSS”. 😩

¹ https://web.archive.org/web/20220901212914/https://deepdive.opensource.org/
